dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>How do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: I behold the magnificent vistas of three thousand worlds and am intimately acquainted with the threads of past and future.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Feebly does the expanse that appears before me endeavor to capture my attention.

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Hmph. No mortal lifetime bears the imagination required to fathom the collective phenomena experienced by the Prinzessin.

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: This place is but a grain of sand in the shadow of my Immernachtreich.

response.speaker: Oz
response.text: But mein Fräulein, you previously said that you wished to stay here for a while.

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: #That... that was but to demonstrate solidarity for {F#her}{M#him} as a kindred soul of the outrealm!

choices.text: As long as you like it.

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: For a mortal domicile, it offers a modicum of respite.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Stalled have I the inexorable march of time and veiled the omnipresent gaze of fate.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Traveler from beyond, the sovereign Prinzessin shall arbitrate the discord of thine heart!

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: What mein Fräulein means is that she happens to be free right now.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: If there is something on your mind, she is happy to listen.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Actually, I want to know if anything is bothering you, Fischl.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Preposterous! I am the Prinzessin der Verurteilung! What mortal follies could venture to imprint themselves upon my psyche?

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: When I was out on reconnaissance, didn't the new recruits from the Adventurers' Guild joke about you since they couldn't understand what you were saying?

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: I remember that you were distressed about this, mein Fräulein.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Nonsense! How could I be perturbed by such trifling antics from my retinue?

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Alas, I lament that those neophytes lack semblance to you, traveler from an outer world, the one delivered before me by the threads of fate.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: The one who perceives the truth and meaning of my declarations.

choices.text: You offer a surfeit of praise.

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Yes, indeed do I perceive rightly...

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: By my regard, should Oz be conducting reconnaissance on my behalf, I grant you permission to remain in my propinquity.

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Now, relay the will of the Prinzessin to her attendants!

response.speaker: Oz
response.text: Frankly, I also think this is a good idea.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What if my understanding is off?

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Allay all doubt, for you are the one that I, the Prinzessin, have personally appointed. Hesitate not and proclaim my decrees to this world's denizens!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: If you two say so...

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: So shall it be.

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Rejoice! That wanton brume of devilry hath dissipated beneath my immaculate radiance!

choices.text: I am honored to understand you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Is there anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Stars cast from the celestial tapestry are the final moments of an hourglass.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Tremors erupting from the earth are the dying echoes of an ancient god's heart.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Shall I usher in this world's desolate finale with none save my own shadow?

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Oh, blessed one...

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: You... Would you accompany me to witness this world's end and greet the descension of eternal night?

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: What mein Fräulein means to say is...

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: O—Oz!

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: W—Wait, really? Are you serious?

response.speaker: Oz
response.text: M—Mein Fräulein...

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Ah! Ahem...!

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Very good! Allow me to offer resplendent blessings to illuminate your fated travels!

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: I, Fischl von Luftschloss Narfidort...

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Along with my familiar of the night, Ozvaldo Hrafnavins, will safeguard your path ahead, for fate has revealed to me that this be decreed!

choices.text: I will be at your side.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Fischl.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: The furtive shades of our destinies intertwine themselves beneath hallowed light. Should tenebrous forces obscure thine path, you may call out my name in humble supplication.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Mein Fräulein says, "Good morning, the sun is quite fine today. If you encounter any difficulties, please call for me."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Fischl.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Profess tribute, for this space is exalted by my consecration. None shall interfere with your repose.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Mein Fräulein says, "Good night. May you have sweet dreams."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Most endearing!

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Who would've thought that one might find such a study outside the treasure trove of the magus-custodian of books...? It is worthy of one's extended stay, and may invoke seven blessings of the Prinzessin out of ten!

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: What mein Fräulein means to say is that most of the literature in this study is of interest to her.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Hee-hee! One has witnessed how you have poured your heart and soul into the pursuit of the heavens and Abyssal Moon.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Travelers, their appetite for adventure insatiable... Surely do they leave the most brilliant marks upon this paradise.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Mein Fräulein means that she enjoys the style of adventurer camps. She never grows tired of it.
